intro: Our Guildrun Tier List ranks heroes for Demo 0.5.5 by build flexibility, synergy potential, opener reliability, and performance from first clears through Red Rift — so you can pick a shop hero with a plan, not just a letter grade.
methodology: Current Demo 0.5.5 balance and kit read (abilities, specializations, class tags).
How often the hero creates a clear shop and formation plan without perfect RNG.
Synergy with common relic engines (Rush, Stall, Shield, Crit, Poison).
Survivability and who eats first contact — carries that need a wall are marked down if they cannot be protected.
Red Rift and hard-content pressure: death caps, long fights, and economy tightness.
Beginner accessibility: heroes that teach the run loop without punishing every mistake.

faq.question: What is the best hero in Guildrun?
faq.answer: There is no single best hero for every shop. On Demo 0.5.5, S-tier picks like Nyx, Irini, and Pimenta show up often in strong clears — but only when you cover their jobs (tank for Nyx, Rush partners for Irini, a carry behind Pimenta). Use this Guildrun tier list as a shortlist, then check the hero page for how to play.

faq.question: Who is the strongest Guildrun hero?
faq.answer: Nyx has one of the highest damage ceilings when protected early and fed Rush resets. Irini is often stronger as a first-clear or flexible carry. For pure frontline, Pimenta and Rowan stabilize boards that otherwise wipe. Strength depends on mode and what the shop offers.

faq.question: Is Nyx good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Yes — Nyx is S tier on this Guildrun hero tier list for Rush-refresh melee carry play. She is weak if she tanks the opener. Buy her with a wall plan, stack Rush and Attack Speed, and read her hero guide for specialization paths.

faq.question: What is S Tier in Guildrun?
faq.answer: S Tier means the hero consistently wins runs when drafted with a sensible supporting cast: clear role, strong relic hooks, and good Red Rift or climb performance. It is not a guarantee without items, ranks, or positioning.

faq.question: How often is the Guildrun tier list updated?
faq.answer: We update when Demo balance or our testing notes change. The version label and last-updated date at the top of this page always show which patch the rankings reflect.

faq.question: Are beginner heroes the same as S Tier?
faq.answer: Not always. Some S-tier carries need precise protection. Beginner-friendly picks (often A/B with simple jobs) appear in Best Modes as Beginner when they teach the loop without high mechanical greed.
